method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original one the best understood as one of the best; English unchanged.
Original already bringing Milosevic to justice retained as campaign claim; he was not transferred to ICTY until 2001, to be explained in annotation.
Original need to the United States read as need for the United States.
Denial of global warming is original candidate stance, not translator scientific assertion.
Original eighty-percent exemption claim retained, not certified as a complete description of Kyoto obligations.
Original nearly nine million count retained without modifying balance or certifying exact estimate.
Plead guilty is rhetorical concession on lack of Washington experience, not admission of a criminal conviction.
Original have not drank read as have not drunk; English unchanged.

revisions.source: We need more spending for America's struggling schools, and national standards and testing to identify and fix poor performers. Every child deserves a strong, functional school to attend.
revisions.zh: 我们需要增加对美国困难学校的投入，并制定全国统一的标准和测试，找出并改善表现不佳的学校。每个孩子都值得上一所教学扎实、运转正常的学校。

revisions.source: We need to increase pay for teachers and increase funding for the Department of Education. I don't support nationwide standards or testing -- they will distort the learning process and lead to education by rote.
revisions.zh: 我们需要提高教师薪酬，并增加教育部的经费。我不支持全国统一的标准或测试——这会扭曲学习过程，导致死记硬背式的教育。

revisions.source: The Social Security system is a financial time bomb. We need to get rid of it, or at the very least cut its benefits significantly.
revisions.zh: 社会保障制度是一颗财政定时炸弹。我们需要废除它，或者至少大幅削减它的福利。

revisions.source: The average worker would do much better if their money was invested in the stock market. I support a plan to allow workers to contribute at least some of their Social Security contribution to an individual investment account.
revisions.zh: 如果把钱投资于股市，普通劳动者会得到好得多的回报。我支持一项计划，允许劳动者将至少部分社会保障缴费存入个人投资账户。

revisions.source: We need to increase benefits for Social Security. Many people can barely survive on the monthly payment, while we spend billions on the military and run a huge budget surplus.
revisions.zh: 我们需要提高社会保障福利。许多人靠每月那点钱几乎无法生存，而我们却把数十亿美元花在军队上，还积累了巨额预算盈余。

revisions.source: The Cold War is over. We should cut defense spending and stop operating so many bases overseas. I would pull troops out of places like Germany and Okinawa, where we are no longer defending anything.
revisions.zh: 冷战已经结束。我们应当削减国防开支，不要再在海外运营那么多基地。我会从德国和冲绳等地撤军，在这些地方，我们已经没有什么需要防卫的了。

revisions.source: America should remain tough, but humble. I am concerned about some of our recent interventions in places like Somalia and Serbia.
revisions.zh: 美国应当保持强硬，但也要谦逊。我对我们最近在索马里和塞尔维亚等地的一些干预感到担忧。

revisions.source: We need to remain an engaged, committed defender of human rights in the world. We should do everything possible to secure the friendship of nations like Russia and China, and to prevent atrocities and genocide in the developing world.
revisions.zh: 我们需要继续积极参与世界事务，坚定捍卫人权。我们应当尽一切努力，与俄罗斯和中国等国建立友好关系，并防止发展中国家发生暴行和种族灭绝。

revisions.source: I would focus on removing dictators like Saddam Hussein and Kim Jong Il from power. They threaten the stability of the world and perpetrate evil upon their people.
revisions.zh: 我会把重点放在让萨达姆·侯赛因和金正日这样的独裁者下台。他们威胁世界稳定，对自己的人民作恶。

revisions.source: Bill Clinton was an embarrassment to the United States, and his impeachment was well-deserved. I believe that he should have been removed from office.
revisions.zh: 比尔·克林顿让美国蒙羞，他遭到弹劾是罪有应得。我认为他应当被免职。

revisions.source: I don't think we need to belabor the point. I pledge to the American people that I will restore honor and dignity to the White House when I am President.
revisions.zh: 我想，我们没必要反复强调这件事。我向美国人民保证，担任总统后，我会让白宫重拾荣誉和尊严。

revisions.source: I am my own man. I respect Bill Clinton in many ways, but his personal conduct was lacking in this case.
revisions.zh: 我有自己的原则。我在许多方面尊重比尔·克林顿，但他在这件事上的个人操守确实有问题。

revisions.source: This is a non-issue. Bill Clinton is one the best Presidents of the last fifty years, and we should be focusing on his policies and successes, not his personal affairs.
revisions.zh: 这根本不是什么问题。比尔·克林顿是过去五十年来最优秀的总统之一，我们应当关注他的政策和成就，而不是他的私生活。

revisions.source: Returning Elian to Cuba was unconscionable. I did not support this decision by the Clinton Administration.
revisions.zh: 把埃利安送回古巴，是不顾良心的做法。我不支持克林顿政府的这个决定。

revisions.source: We should be talking less about Elian, and more about my plans to expand upon the great prosperity of this nation.
revisions.zh: 我们应当少谈埃利安，多谈我的计划，看看如何进一步扩大这个国家的繁荣。

revisions.source: The law is the law. Elian belongs in Cuba with his father. These questions are never easy, but the Clinton Administration and Janet Reno did what they had to do.
revisions.zh: 法律就是法律。埃利安应当回到古巴，与父亲一起生活。这类问题从来不容易，但克林顿政府和珍妮特·雷诺做了他们必须做的事。

revisions.source: This was an issue that had no bearing on the security of the United States. We also ruined any chance of mediation by insisting on the autonomy of Kosovo.
revisions.zh: 这件事与美国的安全毫无关系。我们坚持科索沃自治，也毁掉了任何斡旋的机会。

revisions.source: This certainly helped unseat Slobodan Milosevic, but as President I will make sure that America treads carefully before intervening in foreign nations' affairs.
revisions.zh: 这确实有助于让斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇下台，但作为总统，我会确保美国在干预外国事务前谨慎行事。

revisions.source: I support our actions in this theatre. For minimal cost we were able to stop a potential genocide and put a dictator to justice.
revisions.zh: 我支持我们在这一战区的行动。我们以极小的代价，阻止了一场可能发生的种族灭绝，并让一位独裁者接受司法制裁。

revisions.source: The bombing of Serbia killed many innocent civilians and increased antagonism with Russia and China. I believe military intervention should be a last resort.
revisions.zh: 轰炸塞尔维亚杀死了许多无辜平民，也加剧了与俄罗斯和中国的对立。我认为，军事干预应当是最后的手段。

revisions.source: We need huge tax cuts across the board. Corporate, personal, and capital gains taxes should be slashed. This will further expand the economy through increases in investment.
revisions.zh: 我们需要全面大幅减税。企业税、个人税和资本利得税都应大幅削减。这将增加投资，进一步推动经济增长。

revisions.source: My budget will cut taxes and return a portion of our budget surplus to the American people. Everybody who pays taxes will receive a reduction.
revisions.zh: 我的预算会减税，把部分预算盈余还给美国人民。每个纳税人都能享受减税。

revisions.source: We have a plan for middle class tax cuts. But it would be irresponsible to make huge changes while we still have a large debt.
revisions.zh: 我们有一项为中产阶级减税的方案。但我们仍背负大笔债务，大幅调整会是不负责任的做法。

revisions.source: I have no plan to cut taxes. If anything, we might need some increases to strengthen Social Security.
revisions.zh: 我不打算减税。真要说的话，我们可能还需要加税，以巩固社会保障制度。

revisions.source: I support a strong, overwhelming response against whoever perpetrated this attack. Any government that harbors such terrorists should be overthrown, even if it requires the commitment of American troops.
revisions.zh: 无论是谁实施了这次袭击，我都支持作出强有力、压倒性的回应。任何庇护这类恐怖分子的政府都应被推翻，即使这意味着投入美国军队。

revisions.source: We need to do two things -- first of all we need better procedures to ensure that our forces in dangerous regions do better at protecting themselves. Secondly, we will investigate who is responsible for this attack, be it Al-Qaeda or some other group, and attack them accordingly.
revisions.zh: 我们需要做两件事：首先，改进程序，让部署在危险地区的部队更好地保护自己。其次，查明是谁策划了这次袭击，无论是基地组织还是其他团体，再对其采取相应的打击行动。

revisions.source: This attack was a tragedy, but it underscores the need to the United States to have a more limited foreign policy. The Cold War is over, and it doesn't make sense to deploy troops in so many parts of the world.
revisions.zh: 这次袭击是一场悲剧，但也凸显出美国需要更加克制的外交政策。冷战已经结束，在世界那么多地方部署部队，并不合理。

revisions.source: A crime is a crime, no matter what the motive is. I do not support ideas that some victims should be held in higher regard than others.
revisions.zh: 犯罪就是犯罪，动机是什么都一样。我不支持认为某些受害者应得到比其他人更多重视的观念。

revisions.source: I support increased federal hate crime legislation. No American should ever feel like a target of intimidation because of their identity.
revisions.zh: 我支持加强联邦仇恨犯罪立法。任何美国人都不应因为自身身份，而感到自己成为恐吓的目标。

revisions.source: We have no proof that global warming exists, and we should be expanding our production of coal and oil to obtain energy independence. I would not surrender the sovereignty of our nation for such trivial objectives.
revisions.zh: 我们没有证据证明全球变暖存在，而且我们应当增加煤炭和石油产量，实现能源独立。我不会为了这些微不足道的目标，放弃国家主权。

revisions.source: I would not. The Protocol exempts 80% of the world, including major population centers such as China and India, from compliance, and would cause serious harm to the US economy.
revisions.zh: 我不会支持。议定书让世界上80%的地区免于履行义务，包括中国和印度这样的主要人口大国，而且会严重损害美国经济。

revisions.source: It seems very unlikely that the Senate will ever come up with the votes to ratify this agreement. I don't know how my support or opposition would change that equation.
revisions.zh: 参议院看来极不可能凑齐批准这项协定所需的票数。我不清楚，自己的支持或反对能怎样改变这个局面。

revisions.source: We have worked for years with many other countries to negotiate this agreement. I support the environment and believe the Protocol should be ratified.
revisions.zh: 我们已与许多其他国家协商这项协定多年。我支持环保，认为应当批准议定书。

revisions.source: We have almost 9 million illegal immigrants in this country. I support stronger enforcement of immigration laws to reduce this number.
revisions.zh: 我们国家有将近900万非法移民。我支持加强移民法执法，减少这个数字。

revisions.source: All people contribute to a prosperous America. I support a combination of stronger immigration enforcement with a path to citizenship for people currently in the country. We can do better than we did with the 1986 law.
revisions.zh: 所有人都在为美国的繁荣作贡献。我支持把加强移民执法与为目前在美国的人提供入籍途径结合起来。我们可以比1986年的法律做得更好。

revisions.source: I prefer to focus on making responsible use of our budget surplus and securing prosperity for the next generation of Americans.
revisions.zh: 我愿意把重点放在负责任地使用预算盈余，以及保障下一代美国人的繁荣上。

revisions.source: We need a path to citizenship for those in the country, and we need a system of work permits and strict enforcement on employers, so that immigrants do not depress American wages. We should increase aid to Latin America to reduce the rich-poor divide in our economies.
revisions.zh: 我们需要为已在美国的人提供入籍途径，也需要建立工作许可制度，并严格执法查处雇主，防止移民压低美国人的工资。我们应当增加对拉丁美洲的援助，缩小我们各经济体之间的贫富差距。

revisions.source: Over a million unborn children are killed every year in this country. We need judges who will overturn Roe v. Wade, or we need a Constitutional Amendment to end the practice of abortion.
revisions.zh: 我们国家每年有一百多万未出生的孩子被杀害。我们需要会推翻罗诉韦德案的法官，或者通过宪法修正案，终止堕胎。

revisions.source: I am a pro-life candidate for President, but I understand that we have certain legal protections in place. At the very least, we can end taxpayer funding for this practice.
revisions.zh: 我是一位主张保护未出生生命的总统候选人，但我明白，我们目前已经有一些法律保护。至少，我们可以停止由纳税人出钱资助堕胎。

revisions.source: My goal as President will be to reduce abortions in this country to the lowest level possible. We can increase education and funding for contraception, to reduce unwanted pregnancies. I might be open to ending late-term abortions.
revisions.zh: 作为总统，我的目标是尽可能减少美国的堕胎数量。我们可以加强教育，增加避孕措施的经费，减少意外怀孕。我可能愿意考虑禁止晚期堕胎。

revisions.source: I strongly support the right of a woman to choose. We need to defend this right, and we should increase funding for women's health services, unconditionally.
revisions.zh: 我坚决支持女性自主选择的权利。我们需要捍卫这项权利，并无条件增加女性医疗服务的经费。

revisions.source: Absolutely. Anything we can do to work towards energy independence in this country is a positive step. Oil and coal are the foundation of any energy policy, and should be exploited as much as possible.
revisions.zh: 当然支持。凡是有助于我国实现能源独立的措施，都是积极的一步。石油和煤炭是任何能源政策的基础，应当尽可能开发利用。

revisions.source: This is fine with me, but it is a small part of the overall solution. We need to drill wherever we can, while encouraging innovation in other sectors of the energy market.
revisions.zh: 我对此没有异议，但这只是整体解决办法中的一小部分。我们需要在一切可以钻探的地方钻探，同时鼓励能源市场其他领域的创新。

revisions.source: I oppose these plans. The ANWR is an environmental treasure of the United States, and the oil gained from any exploitation will be relatively limited.
revisions.zh: 我反对这些计划。北极国家野生动物保护区是美国的生态瑰宝，而且开发它能获得的石油相对有限。

revisions.source: This is a giveaway to oil companies that will not resolve America's underlying energy issues. We need more government investment in renewable energy sources, and strict regulations on oil and coal.
revisions.zh: 这是在给石油公司送好处，却无法解决美国根本性的能源问题。我们需要增加政府对可再生能源的投资，并严格监管石油和煤炭行业。

revisions.source: Absolutely. This is just another example of meddling that harms the economy, hurts energy production, and puts hard-working Americans out of work.
revisions.zh: 当然。这又是一个干预经济的例子，损害经济，妨碍能源生产，让勤劳的美国人失业。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, coal is one of the dirtiest forms of energy in existence. I don't see how we can continue to rely on it for the majority of America's energy needs.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，煤炭是现有能源中污染最严重的种类之一。我看不出，我们怎能继续依靠它满足美国大部分能源需求。

revisions.source: This is a necessary step to protect our allies in Europe from current and future threats to their security. I will strongly support this as President.
revisions.zh: 这是保护欧洲盟友免受当前和未来安全威胁的必要措施。作为总统，我会大力支持。

revisions.source: As President, I will reach out to key military leaders for their advice on this issue.
revisions.zh: 作为总统，我会向主要军方领导人征求这方面的意见。

revisions.source: To defend against whom? The Cold War is over and we should be working with Russia, not against them. This is just more unnecessary military spending.
revisions.zh: 防谁？冷战已经结束，我们应当与俄罗斯合作，而不是对抗他们。这只是又一笔不必要的军费。

revisions.source: After eight years of scandals and excesses from the Clinton Administration, I will return this country to its rightful principles -- small government, clean moral conduct, and the freedom of the people.
revisions.zh: 克林顿政府八年来丑闻不断、行事过度，我会让这个国家重新遵循应有的原则——小政府、清正的道德操守，以及人民的自由。

revisions.source: I will ask the American people if they really want to vote for a third term of Bill Clinton, and remind them that I am the true conservative alternative. I will remind them of Al Gore's campaign finance violations and frequent misrepresentations to the American people.
revisions.zh: 我会问美国人民，他们是不是真的想投票给比尔·克林顿的第三届任期，并提醒他们，我才是真正的保守派选择。我会提醒他们，阿尔·戈尔违反竞选资金规定，还经常向美国人民作不实陈述。

revisions.source: Conservatism doesn't mean anger and divisiveness. I will govern as a sensible, pragmatic conservative and pass reforms that are broadly acceptable to the American people. I will return a part of our historic surplus to all of our hard-working families who pay taxes.
revisions.zh: 保守主义并不意味着愤怒和分裂。我会作为一位理智、务实的保守派执政，推动美国人民普遍能够接受的改革。我会把部分创纪录的预算盈余，还给所有辛勤工作、依法纳税的家庭。

revisions.source: As President, I will work with Republicans and Democrats to advocate for programs that all Americans can approve of. We need to move past the divisiveness of recent years and strengthen our economy, Social Security, education, and Medicare. I would prefer to return some of the budget surplus to the people, but I am willing to compromise to get things done.
revisions.zh: 作为总统，我会与共和党人和民主党人合作，推动所有美国人都能赞成的项目。我们需要走出近年来的分裂，巩固经济、社会保障制度、教育和老年医疗保险。我倾向于把部分预算盈余还给人民，但愿意为了办成事情而妥协。

revisions.source: We will emphasize that a vote for Al Gore is a vote for the scandals and liberal policies of the Clinton Administration. We offer a true, conservative alternative to the American people. I will discuss my evangelical Christianity and small-government beliefs.
revisions.zh: 我们会强调，投票给阿尔·戈尔，就是投票支持克林顿政府的丑闻和自由派政策。我们为美国人民提供真正的保守派选择。我会谈论自己的福音派基督教信仰，以及小政府理念。

revisions.source: It is important to nail down our conservative base by emphasizing tax cuts, my evangelical background, opposition to abortion, a strong defense, and limits to government spending. We will ignore Bill Clinton, but paint Al Gore as out of touch.
revisions.zh: 重要的是，通过强调减税、我的福音派背景、反对堕胎、强大的国防和限制政府开支，巩固保守派基本盘。我们不谈比尔·克林顿，但会把阿尔·戈尔描绘成脱离民众的人。

revisions.source: We need to run an attacking campaign against Al Gore. We will expose his misstatements and emphasize that his proposals will squander our budget surplus and greatly increase the size and scope of government.
revisions.zh: 我们需要对阿尔·戈尔发起攻击性竞选。我们会揭露他的不实言论，并强调他的提议将挥霍预算盈余，大幅扩大政府的规模和干预范围。

revisions.source: I will campaign as a conciliatory, moderate conservative. I will emphasize my record as the Governor of Texas, and my support across different groups and parties. We will minimize any talk of budget cuts or overturning existing programs. We will resist the temptation to criticize Bill Clinton.
revisions.zh: 我会作为一位愿意和解的温和保守派展开竞选。我会强调自己担任得克萨斯州州长的政绩，以及跨群体、跨党派的支持。我们会尽量少谈削减预算或推翻现有项目，也会克制批评比尔·克林顿的冲动。

revisions.source: I plead guilty. I don't have experience with the broken political culture of Washington, unlike my opponent. I will clean this system up when I am President.
revisions.zh: 这点我认了。我不像对手那样，熟悉华盛顿败坏的政治文化。担任总统后，我会整顿这个体制。

revisions.source: Let's give a good speech about how I am the mainstream, conservative candidate who will control spending and return our surplus to the American people.
revisions.zh: 我们来好好讲一讲，我是主流的保守派候选人，会控制开支，把预算盈余还给美国人民。

revisions.source: Domestic issues. Let's talk about my plans to reform Social Security, education, and Medicare to ensure the future prosperity of America. Let's remind voters that these are common-sense proposals that appeal to almost everyone.
revisions.zh: 国内问题。谈谈我改革社会保障制度、教育和老年医疗保险的计划，以确保美国未来的繁荣。提醒选民，这些都是合乎常理、几乎人人都能认同的提议。

revisions.source: We need to attack Al Gore's views on the environment, on energy, on taxes, on spending, and on the right direction for our country. He is out of touch with the American people.
revisions.zh: 我们需要攻击阿尔·戈尔对环保、能源、税收、开支，以及国家应走什么方向的看法。他脱离了美国人民。

revisions.source: I will emphasize my record and experience as Governor of Texas. I will remind voters that I have worked across the aisle, won support from many different groups, and will be a uniter, not a divider, when I arrive in Washington.
revisions.zh: 我会强调自己担任得克萨斯州州长的政绩和经验。提醒选民，我曾跨党派合作，赢得许多不同群体的支持；到了华盛顿，我会团结人民，而不是制造分裂。

revisions.source: I will spend the end of my campaign with my brother Jeb in Florida. This state will be critical to our chances.
revisions.zh: 竞选最后阶段，我会与弟弟杰布一起待在佛罗里达州。这个州对我们的胜算至关重要。

revisions.source: I will appear in Pennsylvania and spend the latter half of the day in Ohio. These are two huge states that we can bring into the fold.
revisions.zh: 我会在宾夕法尼亚州露面，当天后半段前往俄亥俄州。这两个大州，我们都可能争取到。

revisions.source: The upper Midwest is key. I will start in Iowa, travel through Wisconsin, and end up in Michigan.
revisions.zh: 中西部北部是关键。我会从艾奥瓦州出发，途经威斯康星州，最后到密歇根州。

revisions.source: We need to focus on states like Missouri, Tennessee, and Arkansas. Clinton may have won them four years ago, but with one last push we can make them go Republican.
revisions.zh: 我们需要着重争取密苏里、田纳西和阿肯色等州。克林顿也许四年前赢过这些州，但最后再努力一把，我们就能让它们转向共和党。

revisions.source: This could destroy my campaign in the final days. We must accuse the Gore campaign of leaking this to discredit my candidacy, and challenge their credibility and timing.
revisions.zh: 这可能在最后几天毁掉我的竞选。我们必须指责戈尔阵营泄露此事，意图抹黑我参选，并质疑他们的可信度和选择这个时机的用意。

revisions.source: I will admit my guilt and apologize to the American people for hiding this story. I will say it was a mistake in judgment to believe that this would not come to light in our modern media environment.
revisions.zh: 我会承认过错，并为隐瞒此事向美国人民道歉。我会说，在现代媒体环境下，以为这件事不会曝光，是我判断失误。

revisions.source: I will emphasize that I made mistakes in the past that I'm not proud of, and that I've always been up front with the American people about that fact. I will also remind the voters that I have not drank alcohol since 1986, and question why this came out five days before the election.
revisions.zh: 我会强调，过去我犯过一些自己并不引以为豪的错误，而且一直坦诚地向美国人民承认这一点。我也会提醒选民，我自1986年以来就不再喝酒，并质疑为什么这事恰好在选举前五天曝光。

revisions.source: I refuse to comment on this issue. My spokeswoman will remind the American people that the real issue is who will be a better President for the country.
revisions.zh: 我拒绝对此发表评论。我的女发言人会提醒美国人民，真正的问题是，谁更适合担任国家的总统。

revisions.source: These stories are absolutely false. I never used illegal drugs and those who say I did are completely mistaken.
revisions.zh: 这些说法完全是假的。我从未使用过非法毒品，说我吸过毒的人完全弄错了。

revisions.source: I did some things when I was younger that I'm not proud of. But my record in office and my conduct over the past two decades is clear. I stopped drinking in 1986 and never looked back.
revisions.zh: 年轻时，我做过一些并不引以为豪的事。但我的执政记录和过去二十年的行为，都是明摆着的。我在1986年戒酒，此后再也没喝过。

revisions.source: These types of stories should be irrelevant to a political campaign. We've all done things when we were young that we're not proud of.
revisions.zh: 这类说法不应与竞选有关。我们年轻时都做过一些并不引以为豪的事。

revisions.source: This is nonsense. I have served as the Governor of Texas, the second largest state in the country, for nearly six years.
revisions.zh: 这简直是胡说。我在美国第二大州得克萨斯州担任州长，已经近六年了。
